pins.name: TX
pins.notes: UART: the part sends data here. Connect to an ESP32 RX pin (57600 baud by default)

pins.name: RX
pins.notes: UART: the part receives data here. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin

pins.name: WAK
pins.notes: Touch output: HIGH when a finger is on the glass, optional
